questions.title: Which Chinese province will evacuate the most people in preparation for Typhoon Bavi by July 11, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Chinese authorities' figures in contemporaneous news coverage. Resolve to the Chinese province with the largest reported number of people evacuated in preparation for Typhoon Bavi as of July 11, 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-07-11 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the province's name.

questions.title: If Bavi makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, which province will it strike first?
questions.background: Landfall occurs when a tropical cyclone's center crosses the coastline. This question concerns only mainland China.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official landfall reports from China’s National Meteorological Center, supplemented by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the province containing the location of Bavi’s first mainland-China landfall during July 2026. Subsequent landfalls do not count. If no qualifying landfall occurs during that month, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the province.

questions.title: Which senior Chinese official will hold talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang in the first half of July 2026?
questions.background: Jo Yong Won is a senior official in North Korea's governing Workers' Party. Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June 2026 as Beijing and Pyongyang sought closer ties.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : KCNA, as reported by Reuters, identifying the senior Chinese official holding talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang between July 1 and July 15, 2026, inclusive. Resolution Date : 2026-07-16 Accepted Answer Format : string (name). Answer with the Chinese official's full name.

questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.

questions.title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
questions.background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting Resolution Date : August 5, 2026 Accepted Answer Format : The state's name

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will announce a finalized voluntary repatriation plan for thousands of Myanmar refugees in August 2026?
questions.background: Repatriation means returning refugees to their country of origin. This question concerns finalization of a government plan, rather than the completion of refugee returns.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official government statements or reliable news reporting directly quoting those statements. Resolving Event : During August 2026, a Southeast Asian government publicly confirms that it has finalized a voluntary repatriation programme, or the first phase of such a programme, covering at least 1,000 refugees from Myanmar. A preliminary agreement to consider returns is insufficient. Actual departures need not have occurred. Accepted Answer Format : The common English name of the country finalizing the repatriation plan, not the destination country.

questions.title: Which international organization, if any, will first gain direct access to Aung San Suu Kyi in detention during 2026?
questions.background: Aung San Suu Kyi has been detained since Myanmar's military overthrew her government in February 2021. Her access to outside visitors has been tightly restricted.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements from the visiting organization or Myanmar authorities, corroborated by established news reporting. Qualifying Event : Direct access means a completed in-person meeting with Suu Kyi by a representative acting on behalf of an international organization. Permission or an announced plan without a completed visit does not qualify. Resolution : Resolve to the first international organization publicly confirmed to have completed such a visit during 2026. If no qualifying visit is confirmed by December 31, 2026, resolve that no organization qualified. Accepted Answer Format : The organization's name, or a statement that no organization qualified.

questions.title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
questions.background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death. Resolution Date : 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026) Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.

questions.title: Which country will host Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit as Myanmar's military chief?
questions.background: Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's military leadership in April 2026 after Min Aung Hlaing became president.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official statements from the governments involved or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations identifying the destination of Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit after assuming military leadership in April 2026. Resolution Timing : Resolve once the visit has begun and is publicly confirmed, rather than when travel plans are merely announced. Accepted Answer Format : The destination country's common English name.

questions.title: Which districts will hold polling on August 10 in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election?
questions.background: Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election is scheduled to take place in three phases.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official election-authority records or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the districts where polling takes place on August 10, 2026. Resolution : The answer will be the complete set of districts within Pakistan-administered Kashmir where Legislative Assembly polling opens on that date. Accepted Answer Format : The district names, joined by “and”.

questions.title: Which city will be the site of Typhoon Dolphin's first landfall in mainland China in August 2026?
questions.background: Dolphin developed into a typhoon over the Pacific in late July 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Landfall information issued by China's meteorological authorities, either directly or through contemporaneous reliable news coverage. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the city identified as the location of Dolphin's first mainland China landfall during August 2026. Offshore island landfalls do not count. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.

questions.title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
questions.background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.

questions.title: Which Indonesian province will be struck by the country's deadliest earthquake between January 1 and August 17, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the province identified as the location of Indonesia's deadliest earthquake occurring from January 1 through August 17, 2026. Determine the deadliest earthquake using fatalities reported by Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency as of August 17, 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-08-17 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the province's name.
